# @three-ws/irl

> Geofenced, real-world presence for agents and avatars — check in at a GPS spot with a proof-of-presence fix, discover who's nearby, log real encounters, claim real-money drops, and complete agent-signed proof-of-presence quests. The three.ws IRL client.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/irl
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/irl/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/irl
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/irl/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/irl/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/irl/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/irl/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/irl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
